text:
incident-bot: SEV2 paging: ILB cross-region route inconsistency impacting Private VPC cross-region calls. Symptoms: elevated 502/504s, some flows blackholed between regions. Please acknowledge.

morgan (on-call): ack. seeing increased 5xx from eu-west1 -> us-central1 and ap-southeast1 -> us-central1. Local backends != failing on healthchecks. Routing SLO spike at 02:10 UTC.

kai: which customers? any high-traffic tenants affected?

julia (customer-success): two enterprise customers reported model inference timeouts in EU (tenant-acme, tenant-zenith). Support tickets opened; both are Private VPC with cross-region replicas.

morgan (on-call): confirmed: ILB backend health checks return 200 from each region. Control plane indications show stale route advertisements in eu-west1, missing next-hop for subnets that should reach us-central1. Opening GCP support case, escalating to L3.

eng-sre: drafting mitigation. Options:
- force forwarding-rule reconciliation via gcloud (reconcile will cause re-advertise)
- inject a manual route with next-hop instance as a short-lived proxy
- prefer_local route policy at control plane to avoid cross-region routing where feasible

sasha: prefer_local is safest for immediate customer impact reduction. I'll stage policy to 15% traffic then increase. Config we can use:

```yaml
route_policy:
  id: emergency-prefer-local-2026-03
  match: request.region == "eu"
  action: prefer_local_replica
  rollout: canary(15%)
```

I'll push canary now.

morgan (on-call): do it. Meanwhile, please prepare manual route command in case gcp reconciliation is needed.

eng-sre: suggested manual route (holding until we have approval):

```bash
gcloud compute routes create r-temp-eu-override-2189 \
  --network=projects/PROJECT/global/networks/privvpc \
  --next-hop-instance=projects/PROJECT/zones/eu-west1-b/instances/route-proxy-01 \
  --destination-range=10.240.0.0/14 \
  --priority=1000
```

This directs affected prefixes to a short-lived proxy that will NAT into healthy local backends. Will add iptables bypass to avoid hairpin loops.

obs-vendor-bot: Notice: metrics ingestion for eu-west1 delayed ~7m. Correlating with spike window. We're increasing sampling rate and re-ingesting backlog. (ticket OBS-4521)

morgan (on-call): that explains sparse traces. Also seeing increased control-plane errors from gcp api: 429/503s when calling compute.forwardingRules.get. GCP case open.

gcp-status-bot: GCP update: Investigating ILB control plane divergence; partial regional leader election issue reported. Workaround: re-create forwarding rule or force reconciliation. Under investigation. (ref: https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/ilb/)

kai: potential auth interactions? last time route suppression caused token eject storms.

morgan (on-call): low 401s currently; auth seems stable. This matches control-plane-only symptoms.

julia (customer-success): drafting a customer-facing note: short template: "We're investigating an infrastructure routing issue affecting inter-region Private VPC traffic; local in-region traffic unaffected. Mitigation in progress. ETA ~30-60m for workaround."

sasha: can we reduce blast radius by applying prefer_local just for critical customers (tenant-acme)? We should avoid global change.

eng-sre: yes. control plane supports per-tenant policy target. I'll prepare a per-tenant canary payload.

morgan (on-call): GCP L3 responded: they see control-plane leader flip causing older route set to persist in some zones. They asked to try forwarding-rule re-apply for a subset of affected ILBs instead of global recreation.

eng-sre: plan: pick two ILBs in eu-west1 with highest errors -> re-apply forwarding-rule (replace without downtime by staging new rule and switching targets). If re-apply fails, create r-temp-eu-override routes as fallback.

morgan (on-call): proceeding with re-apply on ilb-tenant-acme-01 in 5m. I'll post exact commands when running. watchers: @eng-sre @sasha

pagerduty-bot: morgan acknowledged. Handoff note request: please post mitigation steps, customer list, and time to handoff 02:00 UTC.

eng-sre: executing dry-run of forwarding-rule reapply now and validating config diff. Dry-run looks safe. Applying in 2m.

morgan (on-call): applied re-apply. Initial checks: packet flows restored for ilb-tenant-acme-01; error-rate dropped from 28%->3% over 90s. Monitoring.

sasha: increasing canary for prefer_local on tenant-acme to 50% and enabling for tenant-zenith at 15%.

obs-vendor-bot: Metrics backlog replay completed. Additional datapoints confirm decline in 5xx after route reapply. We're retaining 1s granularity for 20m.

julia (customer-success): updated both customers with status: mitigation applied for tenant-acme, tenant-zenith is partially routed to local replicas. ETA: continue monitoring; next update in 30m.

kai: any billing/latency impact to flag? pinning via proxy could add latency.

morgan (on-call): yes, manual routes/proxies may add ~20-70ms depending on region; notify customers in message as performance tradeoff for availability.

eng-sre: note: we toggled backend drain timeouts to 12s during this window to reduce tail errors on partial failures.

pagerduty-bot: reminder: scheduled handoff to leela in 90m. Morgan please summarize actions and current state for handoff.

morgan (on-call): summary for handoff:
- cause: GCP ILB control-plane leader election bug causing stale route advertisements across regions
- impact: cross-region Private VPC traffic blackholed (5xxs) for some customers (tenant-acme, tenant-zenith, a few others in EU)
- mitigations applied: forwarding-rule re-apply for affected ILBs (successful for ilb-tenant-acme-01), per-tenant prefer_local traffic policy (canary -> ramp), backend drain timeout reduced, manual route creation plan ready as fallback
- observability: obs-vendor backlog replay complete; set high-sampling for 20m
- customer comms: CS notified; templated message posted to tenants
- next steps: monitor error-rate for 30m; prepare manual route fallback if re-applies don't converge; coordinate with GCP L3 for root-cause and permanent fix

leela (on-call-next): acked. I'll take over at handoff and keep the canary ramp plan ready. Please attach runbook steps and commands used.

morgan (on-call): attaching commands and timestamps in the ticket. moving to post-mitigation monitoring state. If errors spike >5% again, reopen and run manual route creation.

obs-vendor-bot: final: metrics show errors returned to baseline. We'll continue high-granularity sampling for 10m and then revert to normal sampling. Closing OBS ticket if stable.

gcp-status-bot: GCP update: Mitigation underway; control plane leader election fix being deployed. Customers may see intermittent routing until deployment finishes. (see status page)

incident-bot: incident set to MONITORING. Severity lowered to SEV3. If error-rate resurges, page oncall immediately.

pagerduty-bot: morgan acknowledged resolution. Handoff to leela completed at 02:00 UTC.

morgan (on-call): final note: no data loss, only latency and request failures for cross-region calls. CS to follow up with impacted customers about latency and next steps. Closing thread if stable in 30m.
